notes: Added missing schema/contract and core enforcement hardening stories to complete feature coverage.

GPTR-F-001-S101.title: Request Schema and Allowlist Contract Definition
GPTR-F-001-S101.description: Define strict request schema for GPTReader including allowed collections, fields, operators, query depth, and response limits using Pydantic models to enforce contract validation prior to execution.

GPTR-F-001-S102.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Engine
GPTR-F-001-S102.description: Implement core validation engine that enforces allowlist rules against incoming queries, including collection-level access control, field-level filtering, operator restrictions, and max document/query limits.

GPTR-F-001-S103.title: Failure Handling and Safe Rejection Responses
GPTR-F-001-S103.description: Standardize rejection responses for invalid or disallowed queries with explicit reason codes, ensuring no sensitive schema or backend details are exposed while maintaining debuggability.
